samples.question: A dark curve enters from the left and disappears behind an opaque grey vertical band. Three coloured curves - red, green and blue - come out of the band's right edge and never touch each other. Exactly one of them is the dark curve's continuation: it is the same single smooth curve carried on behind the band, so where it leaves the band its height and its direction of travel are those the dark curve would have if it kept going smoothly. Of the other two, one leaves the band at exactly the height where the dark curve met the band, and one travels in the same direction as the true continuation but at a different height. Which coloured curve is the continuation of the dark curve? Answer red, green or blue.
